notes:
Summary: Sable Sentinel is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for an inference platform to run customer-facing fraud scoring and internal analyst assistants. Primary constraints: EU data residency, PCI scope reduction, and full audit trail to Splunk for 3 years. Short bullets below.

- Deployment ask: private control plane in their EU VPC or an on-prem option for air-gapped clients. BYOK mandatory (AWS KMS preferred).
- Compliance mapping: require explicit mapping of Redwood controls to SOC 2 (CCM/CIS mapped), ISO 27001 Annex A controls, and PCI DSS SAQ D/ROSA considerations for hosted models. They also want a statement about PHI handling: not core but some clients are healthcare — legal wants HIPAA/BAA note ("right now primary need is PCI, but HIPAA could be requested").
- Network/security: no public egress from inference subnets; egress-only via monitored NAT for updates and only to approved endpoints. VPC endpoints for S3, KMS, and logging. Firewall rules must be documented.
- KMS: BYOK flow requested — customer-managed CMKs in their AWS account, cross-account key grants for Redwood Private nodes, HSM/FIPS compatibility. Legal wants sample BYOK clause and key rotation SLA.
- Audit logging: requirements -> token-level request logs, model-version metadata, user-id mapping; logs forwarded to Splunk via private collector; retention 3 years for compliance; immutable WORM recommended.
- Data residency: all inference data, KV cache, evals, and logs to remain in EU regions (primary: eu-west-1). No backups replicated outside EU unless explicit consent.
- SLA/controls: need SOC 2 Type II report for the Private control plane or equivalent attestation and ISO 27001 cert preferred. For PCI, architecture must show tokenization flow or out-of-scope handling to minimize cardholder data touching the model.
- Pricing/contract: looking at 12–36 month commitment depending on BYOK and retention pricing. Estimated ARR band indicated above.

Quotes/notes from calls: "Must not leave EU boundary for any inference artifacts" — Head of Security. "We need to see an actual SOC2 mapping table to our questionnaire items" — Compliance lead.

Open asks: provide SOC2 control mapping spreadsheet, BYOK design diagram, PCI scoping guidance (SAQ D vs. tokenization options), sample contract language for KMS + audit log handling. POC acceptance criteria: end-to-end sample showing request flow, KMS encrypt/decrypt, and Splunk ingestion of audit events.

Links: security questionnaire file in Drive; refer to tickets INF-3129 and SEC-4401 for current technical questions.
